Look at that. All the way to the end with only one push.
Oh, I almost forgot. I brought you all a little something.
Oh, quit cogitating, Steinmetz, and use an open-faced club! The sand wedge!
Smithers, what are you doing up here?
Cheating for me? Good lord, Smithers, that's patently unnecessary. I'm one of the world's finest golfers! In all the years you've caddied for me, I've never lost a-- Oh.
But does your wife?
Where's Homer? Oh, and to think I spent all afternoon baking him this cake.
I pickled the figs myself.
Here. Tell me how my stocks did yesterday.
Look, stop calling me and start enjoying your vacation. Remember, I want to see lots of pictures when you get back.
I asked for light starch on my nightcap!
You call this a tax return?!
Uh... no! I'm... uh... making it myself!
Ahoy-hoy? No, you have the wrong number. This is 5-2-4-6. I suspect you need more practice working your telephone machine. Not at all. Ahoy.
Thank you, thank you, thank you!
Stop that! Stop that at once! You're fighting!
Would you do the honors...?
Well, Simpson, seven gone. As soon as you're in your pressboard coffin, I'll be the sole survivor, and the treasure will be mine!
I'm sending you a photo over the Faxtrola. I need you to fly to Springfield and assassinate this man post-haste.
"Dead -- tired," but I'm quite refreshed now, thank you.
Hmm. I'd rather do both.
This may take a while, Smithers. Why don't you get drunk and stumble around comically for my amusement?
You're what? Selling light bulbs? Worried about the whales? Keen on Jesus? Out with it!
Nonsense, Larry, your blood is bluer than any of theirs! Just give them a snootful of the old Burns charm!
Summon my son at once!
Well, son, delighted to have met you. It's good to know that there's another kidney out there for me.
So, another Friday is upon us. What'll you be doing, Smithers? Something gay, no doubt.
Is it supposed to take this long? What's a good time for a mass evacuation of the entire plant?
Sir, I am in your debt.
We must be covered by a thousand feet of snow.
Ooh. That takes me back. God bless you Shary Bobbins.
Why that canine has the proud bearing and glossy fur coat of a Yale man. Hello, little fella.
Smithers, I believe this dog was in Skull and Bones.

I'll keep it short and sweet. Family, religion, friendship: these are the three demons you must slay if you wish to succeed in business. When opportunity knocks, you don't want to be driving to the maternity hospital or sitting in some phony baloney church. Or synagogue. Questions?
Grocery store, please!
Oh, thank you, Shoppie. I... I ventured in to search for milk when the door snapped shut behind me.
Wh... where are you taking me? What's happening?
Egad, man, how are we supposed to pass the time?
You! The troublemaking girl!
Nothing evil. That's exactly the kind of radical thinking I need! It's a deal.

Yes, thank you, everyone. But -- 10% of your applause should go to my little partner, Lisa Simpson. For if it were not for her infectious moralizing, we would not be here today to witness the unveiling of... The Li'l Lisa Recycling Plant!
Oh, hold your accolades to the end of the tour. You haven't seen the best part!

I call our product: Li'l Lisa's Patented Animal Slurry! It's a high-protein feed for farm animals, insulation for low-income housing, a powerful explosive, and a top-notch engine coolant. And best of all, it's made from 100% recycled animals!

Smithers, I've just seen the most heroic dog on television. He pulled a toddler from the path of a speeding car, then pushed a criminal in front of it. Find this dog. I want to make him my executive vice president.
How dare you destroy my valuable wall and spill my priceless acid?! Did you really think you were going to get away with it?
Yes, yes, of course.
Yes -- Uh, then I'll form my own religion!
With its own symbol. We'll use this Special K!
Ahoy hoy, lowly mortals! In addition to working for me, you may now praise me as your Almighty!
Oh, stop fishing for compliments, Smithers. Go home to your can of mushroom soup.
Hmm... A pack of vicious dogs should be ripping you to pieces...
What is this? What are you doing?
Remove the chocks, Simpson. Simpson?
So, you say Batista's gone? Did you know that?
Yes, of course. Mr. Power.
Deploy the cow catcher.
The man has no idea how to behave like a billionaire. Where's the dignity? Where's the contempt for the common man?
Are you still here?
I want you to look at me the way I saw you look at Arthur Fortune.
Oh, well, when I was six, my father took me on a picnic. That was a gay old time. Oh-ho, I ate my share of wieners that day.
Stop that! Attention wireless listeners! Most of the sounds you are now hearing are not being made by me.
Oh, stop! Stop! Won't someone please stop the farting?
Peter Graves couldn't find ugly at a Radcliffe mixer!
No, no! Stop it! Stop it! You'll enrage the beast!
And hoarding! Leave it to the Democrats to let the Spaniards back in the pantry.
Oh, there go my shin bones again.
"Thank you all so much. I love Springfield, from the cuddliest infant to th... ... puppies... patriotism... bluebirds..." I'm not reading this drivel. This speech is over.
Oh, try this arm. I saw some blood in there the other day.
Well, Doc, I think I did pretty well on my tests. You may shake my hand if you like.
Well, let's see. Ming vase on narrow column, not knocked down... priceless coins not used in vending machine...
Well, with the old ball and chain gone, maybe I can finally have a little fun at the office.
All right, prank monkey, let's make mischief.
Take that back for nine hundred and three dollars.
Prepare to be boarded!
This place is falling apart.
It seems the Federales have been tipped off by an anonymous whistle blower.
Oh, General Gao... you were a bloodthirsty foe, but your chicken is delectable.
That was my thumb.
Excellent. Let me fetch you another Thomas Collins.
Look, there's one of my young chums now. You there!
Gloria, say you'll marry me.
My Gloria is still inside! Save her!
Never forget, Homer, there's no muscle stronger than the human heart.
I'm absolutely evil!
I'm afraid that skull belongs to my dear friend... Waylon Smithers, Sr.
You've already done enough, Nader.
No, I'm having one!
Why are you laughing? His bungling has shortened your lives and mutated your children.
Number one, the Kingston Trio. Number two...
Welcome, fellow Republicans. To start with the old business, Brother Hibbert will read a report on our efforts to rename everything after Ronald Reagan.
Oh, have you now? Well huzzah, huzzah. I'll just throw back my legs and pollute my britches with delight.
Who wants a kiss? Who wants a kiss?
You're quite the friendly fellow, but right now I'm looking for a patsy.
Finally, I would like to add to any nuclear inspectors in the crowd, that the titular head of the power plant is now Mr. Homer J. Simpson.
So, the caterpillar has emerged from its cocoon as a shark with a gun for a mouth. I only have one thing to say to that... bravo.
Keep begging. You're just wasting precious oxygen!
Which you've committed at every national park, from Acadia to Zion. You're going away for a long time, Mrs. Simpson. Or should I call you...
Ah yes, the automated teller machine-eola-trola-maton.
Smithers, what's my password?
Young man, I believe you have something that belongs to me.
Oh look, it's Kathy! How are things in personnel?
I'll sign your petition!
Another employee family wedding. What's the traditional peasant gift in these parts? A milking cow?
Now pie that Brownie, fruitcake!
Ga-ga. Goo-goo. Your assignment.
I survived on whatever sustenance came my way.
Here it comes.
I have been eighty-nine for a while now.
This town cared more for a soulless piece of granite than for me! I don't have a friend in the world.
And play that delightful flush sound on your way out.
Splendid! Now, let's see how I'm faring on the jumping box.
Very well, you had your chance. I'm going to shred you like a Christmas card! Now, get out.
I can't be held responsible for what my goons were ordered to do!
Non-violence never solved anything! Fine, curtsy boy, I'll try it your way.
My league! My beautiful league! All dead!
Well, I guess it's impossible to control all the media -- unless of course, you're Rupert Murdoch. He is one beautiful man.
Now, I insist you take off your shoes when you get inside. And uh, while you're in there, grab as much cancer as you can.
You're suspended without pay! Take your clacking balls and go.
Well, well, if it isn't my favorite employee and his spouse. And these must be children. Have a ginger root.
And these two are gifts for my nephews. Tally ho!
Good Heavens! Grab a sponge, man!
You can't escape me, Simpson -- you're not smart enough!
Enough! While you morons are canoodling, someone's burgling my miscellania!
Good Lord! A wooly bully!
So long, sucker!
I mean, don't leave an old man to die.
One day a new member arrived at the club...
I had to get a job. And I had to start at the bottom. But to get to the bottom, I had to work my way up from Moe's.
Take me, a barren old thistle, and spare this sweet young flower!
I'll catch up with you.
What a great film, and I think it makes a terrific point: effective immediately, I'm closing the plant and moving all operations to India.
Welcome, new employees of the Bangalore Nuclear Power Plant.
Now if you'll excuse me, I'm late for a dinner engagement. I don't want my scooped-out monkey head to get cold.
Are you still here? Go pay for that!
I've heard enough! Release the hounds!
Excellent. But since I thought you were dead, you won't get paid this week. Make a note of it.
Look at that rabble-rouser! He's threatening our ill-gotten gains!
Now, why don't you listen to the musical stylings of Mr. Lionel Richie.
Let's see, I'll take his liver, a case of Adam's apples, that motorcycle man's moustache...
To the Betty and Herbert Weinstein Pavilion!
The Springfield Opera House, of which I am founder, artistic director, and standing ovation starter, is producing La Bohème. I want you to sing the lead.
Hey, I've seen your wife. She's no Mamie Van Doren.
I've won every coin. But I feel strangely empty. Ooh, there's another coin. That should do it.
If you're really a billionaire, give me the secret billionaire's handshake. Smithers, turn away.
MY COUNTRY 'TIS OF THEE / AUSTRIA-HUNGARY...
Excellent speech. Just excellent. I no longer wish to build my magnificent new basketball stadium.
Nor will we have the chance to marvel at number one draft pick Muk Mu, the human North Pole.

...so that's how I was outfoxed by a little girl and her half-wit companion. When my beautiful stadium was declared a bee sanctuary, and I had to take a third-quarter writedown of eight hundred four million dollars.
Wait, wait, wait, it's only a matter of four million. I'm sure I can find that somewhere. I, uh, I have fifty dollars here in my wallet...
Oh, I've known about the gem for years. You see, my dear girl, I joined the Freemasons before it was trendy. That's my eyeball on the dollar bill.
Hence I trailed you on your quest, accompanied by my faithful albino.
Ah, I expect you're all anxiously awaiting my choice for your new supervisor.
No! No! This is our year! How can this be happening?
Oh, indeed it is. Tonight I will be continuing my courtship of Princess Wilhelmina of Prussia.
Surprised? Me, C. Montgomery Burns, locked up like an animal.
Spare ribs, eh? I've played a round of tenpins or two in my life, and to me, the word "spare" reeks of second best. Give me ten full frames of strike ribs!
Yes. They should go. Just as soon as they perform this musical I've written in celebration of our nation's birth.
Be strong, Smithers. Be strong for the plant. She needs you.
Yes... but a wealthy man can buy information, information that can be highly damaging to a certain warden.
Well I'm sure the boys at the city desk would be interested to learn that you're addicted to... to...
I haven't had a cavity in over forty years.
I was afraid you'd be some tattooed bruiser.
But first, I'll daydream about a sport utility vehicle, a crispy chicken sandwich, and a wonderful blue pill.
I LIVE ME IN A MANSION / FULL OF THOSE GRECIAN URNS / BUT I'M LONELY ALL THE LIVE-LONG DAY / THAT'S THE BLUES OF MONTY BURNS
I see. I am well and truly hated. However, you will change your tune when you see the legacy I'm leaving behind me.
Really? You don't say. Did you know about this?
Young man, would you like a lemon drop?

It wasn't kindness that was keeping me alive, it was bile building up inside! Loathing is my life blood and rage my royal jelly! So yes, thank you, Springfield, for giving me the secret to eternal life -- hate!
Just what's going on here?
It's a Christmas miraculum!
You lied to me! Release the hounds!
I kissed a girl and I liked it! All is forgiven, Simpsons. Go and enjoy Ha-va-eee.
Just as soon as we sing one Christmas carol.
Well. This is awkward.
Smithers, you are the campiest of my aides du camp, but I'm afraid my true admiration is reserved for the self-made man. No Steve Woz-ni-ak thee.
Pish tush! Wayne, as a reward for your valiant fisticuffery, I hereby award you the Springfield Nuclear Plant Silver Safety Hat!
Just give me your answer! And make it quick! Our current "account man," Robert Marlowe here, is retiring at the end of the month.
How ironic. I survived the Titanic by making a raft out of steerage passengers and now this!
I don't think so.
Well, bah to them. Let's go, Smithers.
Only one of you monkeys wasn't caught with his sticky paw in my tin cup... Homer Simpson!
Now Simpson, how is it that you alone manage to keep your moral compass pointed to true north?
It's time for afternoon announcements.
Simpson, wait! As it turns out, there is one job available. But be forewarned, it promises naught but soul-crushing boredom.
Fine! Slink away! And guess what: all those times I said "you're a good boy," it was a lie!
Ahh. The solarium. We'll be safely cornered in this glass room with one door.
Stop brandishing me!
Oh, that's right. I have his memories because I ate his brain.
Now we will use unfettered free market principles to arrive at a number. Release the hounds!
And there you have it, folks -- rates will rise a healthy seventeen percent. And now, to help you disperse...
Pshaw, I say!
Please, Abe, let me buy you dinner in exchange for a few tales of the golden age of professional grappling.
Would you ever consider throwing your wig back into the ring?
WHEN YOU'RE THE VILLAIN OF THE SHOW /

IT'S A HIGH TO BE LOA-THED! / CHUCKY, STALIN, MEGATRON / ERIC CARTMAN, DONKEY KONG / VADER, NADER, SIMON LEGREE / TERMINATORS ONE, TWO AND THREE / IAGO, JOKER, VOLDEMORT / MCENROE ON CENTER COURT / MR. BURNS AND SKELETOR / KEEP YOUR GOOD GUYS, WHAT A SNORE
Hear that lion's roar of determination.
Hist! Look there!
The police? Bah! Every last man on the take. And I should know, because I'm on the give.
A civilian! She mustn't know I'm a hero! Gouge her eyes out!
I open one, no trump.
Your plan failed! Thank god this plant has never had a functioning air conditioner.
Let this be a lesson to those who love cash, that your nice stash of cash could be gone in a flash. And if you are awful and nasty and cruel...
Or gape in terror at Almighty God's whoopsy-daisies...the Freaks!
And now... I must ask that small children leave, good women avert their eyes, and men take a stiff slug of circus whiskey... behold, the most hideous creature of all!
Those raked rocks could've been me! Now since you're so good at finding things, find the exit!
Who moved my desk?!
Well then, I should disrobe at once. Housekeeping! Send up a Chinese dressing screen! And one of Firestone's finest vulcanized prophylactics! Be right back.
Smithers! Run down to Sears Roebuck and get a five-eighths inch Phillips head bolt!
You know what? I think I'll give it another five.

location: Phineas Q. Butterfat's 5600 Flavors Ice Cream Parlor
dialogue: Right here! Now, Smithers. I want you to eat this for me, describe every taste, and don't forget the brain freeze!
Don't worry. This Santa still has claws!
What's wrong with this thing?
Who are you?!
Best I've ever had. And that includes... Nellie Taft.
I have to buy the mineral rights for every single parcel of land in Evergreen Terrace. To win people over, I'll need a salesman whose folksy façade masks a deep gusher of greed.
I have embarked on a "beneficial friendship" with a woman with whom I have nothing in common. Her opinions are abhorrent to me. But the passion... well, look at these racy texts she sends me.
Stop this ribbon cutting! This is private property!
You're just doing this to get back at me for dumping you!
The Antonin Scalia bedroom!
I wish we had bought the more expensive theater tickets. I'll never see anything in row BB.
Could you... repeat that first part?
Once more, with feeling!
I was going to say "get out," but your idea sounds better.
One, two, three!
Not on my carpet!
A human zoo?
They say you catch more flies with honey. I say with flytraps!
...and upon leaving you will each receive a piece of orangewood to bite down on during childbirth. Excellent.
Curse that Elon Musk! Thanks to that Earth-smooching buttinski, I'm on the verge of bankruptcy. All I have left are the clothes on my back and the clones in my freezer.
I'll have the berries.
Oh, this is for me.
That man is the perfect choice.
Oh great! Here comes the haggling!
There's never a bright side!
Oh God, what do you want?
Where are the hounds when I need them?
Good boy. Boys, let's see your hands.
Oh. Better yet.
Simpson! Let's move on now, Mother, shall we?
Okay, Mother. This way.
Mmm-hmm. I understand completely. The disturbing incident I was referring to happened this morning, when your son flushed an explosive device down the boys' lavatory.

Well, perhaps I was being a tad glib. Let me explain. Our elementary school participates in a foreign exchange program. Now normally, a student is selected on the basis of academic excellence or intelligence, but in Bart's case I'm prepared to make a big exception. And, if you're willing to play along, he can spend the next three months studying far, far away.
No, no, no, no. A student from Albania. It's a country on the Adriatic Sea.

You may find his accent peculiar. Certain aspects of his culture may seem absurd, perhaps even offensive. But I urge you all to give little Adil the benefit of the doubt. In this way, and only in this way, can we hope to better understand our backward neighbors throughout the world.
Well thank you, Bart. I only hope that for the next few hours you and I can leave our differences in the schoolyard.

location: Hallway Outside Selma And Patty's Apt.
dialogue: Ah, excellent suggestion. I suggest we start with The Springfield Revolving Restaurant. You know, food tastes better when you're revolving.
Indeed, truly terrible.
Oh.. uh... sorry.
Ah... Bart, I hate to pull you away from your daily exercise, but ... well...
I can't afford that! I'm an educator.
You love me! Caloo Calay!
See you again?
Farewell, my Pattycake.
Malignant spirochetes infest your bloodstream, eventually spreading to your spinal fluid, and on into the brain.

For the next week I stayed alive by eating my mother's delicious preserves and maintained my sanity by dribbling a nearby basketball with my one free hand. I made a game of it, seeing how many times I could bounce the ball in a day, then trying to break that record. Occasionally the police arrived to search my home.
This act is over! Well, ladies and gentlemen, I'd like to put this filth behind us, and let's all enjoy Lisa Simpson's rendition of "Stormy Leather -- ah, Weather."
Oooh, now, you get to wear a sash...
Forgery. So he didn't have leprosy.
Bart, the police haven't had any luck finding the teachers' editions.
And a state of the art detention hall, where children are held in place with magnets.
Oh, it's a miracle no one was hurt.
I drove an all-terrain vehicle in Da Nang. I think I can handle it.
Otto. That's one palindrome you won't be hearing for awhile.
Yes, hail to the bus driver... Bus Driver Man!
And the winner of the blimp ride is... Homer Simpson!
Very well, I'll continue to wait.
Well, I'm afraid classes may be canceled today.
Ah, music and art.
Oh, there's mother now. Watching me. What's that, mother? They have a right to be here. It's school business. I... Mother, that sailor suit doesn't fit anymore!
Some student -- possibly Bart Simpson -- has been circulating candy hearts featuring crude, off-color sentiments. Well let me tell you something, Valentine's Day is no joke...
Good evening, everyone, and welcome to a wonderful evening of theater and picking up after yourselves.
Dah! What the...?
I'm disrupting the learning process... and I love it!
Lisa, every good scientist is half B.F. Skinner, and half P.T. Barnum. I don't think I need to see the other exhibits. First prize!
On another topic, the following students have won mountain bikes: Bart Simpson...
Superintendent Chalmers! Welcome!
So what's the word down at One School Board Plaza?
We are not.
What is it with you kids and that word? I'm going to shave you bald, young man, until you learn that hair is not a right, it's a privilege.
Blasted woman, you parked too close. Move your car.
Uh, there is an added bonus -- some of the revenue can go to help our under-funded public schools!
Oh, he's so charming!
Good lord! It's coming up right behind him!
Children, teachers, back to your rooms! Uh-oh, whenever I get this upset, I get hiccups. Ooh, right on cue.
I ... can't ... take ... this .
Bart! How are you? How's school?
No, no, Luigi, I'd like one with two seats. I'll be dining with a friend tonight.
Hmm. They treat you real nice here.
Hmm. Yes, Colonel. Now, I understand it will be my duty to mold the new recruits into a well-disciplined, highly-trained infantry unit.
Man on the range!! Change your trajectories!!!
Actually, it's exactly as I remembered it. I do want to come back, Bart, but it doesn't sound like Flanders is gonna get fired.
...Yes. Now you realize, if I become Principal again, we can no longer be friends. Unless you become a good student.
"Please excuse my handwriting. I busted whichever hand it is I write with. Signed, Mrs. Simpson." You were right to be suspicious, Edna. To the crime lab.
We did not! Now where's Bart? You better tell me!
Why, there are no children here at the Four 'H' Club either! Am I so out of touch? No. It's the children who are wrong.
I can't wait 'til the sentencing part. That's where I really shine.
Um, how about if we tell you our problems with relationships?
Door to door sugar? What a marvelous idea! What's that, mother? I'm just talking to the sugar man. Mother, I'm a big boy. I can do as I wish. Excuse me.
Thanks a lot, Simpson! Now I'm grounded!
Ah, at least have the guts to take the blame, girl. You're only compounding your folly by lying about it.

Young lady, cow hearts belong in a butcher's window, not the classroom. Well, maybe in an older student's biology classroom, but that's none of my business. Elementary school is where I wound up and it's too late to do anything about that. Frankly, I'm starting to regret skipping you ahead.
Prepackaged Star Wars characters still in their display box?! Are those the limited edition action figures?
Why, it's Luke, and Obie-Wan... and my favorite, Chewie. They're all here! What do you think?
We have a winner!
Now, as a special send-off and a way to say "Gung hay fat choy" to our visiting Chinese principals, Bart Simpson has promised us a fireworks display!
Over here, Simpson! The detention room is dangerously overcrowded, so you'll be serving your time in the cafeteria.
Wouldn't it be wonderful if there were some sort of common solution to both our problems?
Jimbo, this is by far the worst...
I'm going to enjoy devouring you, Bart Simpson. Yes... I believe I'll start, as you've so often suggested, by eating your shorts.

Attention. This is Principal Skinner, your principal, with a message from the principal's office. All students please proceed immediately to an assembly in the Butthead Memorial Auditorium. Dammit I wish we hadn't let the students name that one.
Muntz, Nelson. You're failing history, geography, and math. But ah, you're doing quite well in Home-Ec.
Whoever brings down that balloon doesn't have to learn fractions!
There's Orion... the Swan...the chariot race...
No, no there's no need for that... it's already named after me.
About the ox?
We've been invited to the wedding of our only graduate to read at an adult level.
Five dollars a child?! Last year it was free.
Yeah, in a dream world. We have a very tight budget. To do what she's asking, we'd have to raise taxes.
It'll cost you.
Let us out, Bart! / This is not funny, come on! / Bart, let us out right now!
Hmm. School normally doesn't smell so... rank.
Willie, sometime over the holiday weekend, the beloved Grade Four gerbil, er, Superdude, lost his life. I need you to air out the classroom and give Superdude a proper burial.
My Lord. Such destruction.
Hm, it's an unrelated article.
Oh mercy. Seriously though, before we draw up the budget, I believe the students and faculty have a few suggestions...
That hotel's a dump, and your monopoly is pathetic. The school's oil well is not for sale. Particularly to a black-hearted scoundrel like yourself!

Today, Springfield Elementary embarks on a new era: an era of unbridled spending where petro-dollars will fuel our wildest educational fantasies. These young minds will enjoy every academic advantage... ...until they enter Springfield High School, which has no oil well.
He robbed the school of financial security!
Strange. I shouldn't have been able to hear that. Anyway, a Hollywood studio has decided to film the Radioactive Man movie here in Springfield.

Good morning class. A certain agitator -- for privacy's sake let's call her Lisa S. -- No, that's too obvious. Uh, let's say L. Simpson -- has raised questions about certain school policies. So in the interest of creating an open dialogue, sit silently and watch this film.
Ahhh, these uniforms are a godsend. Horseplay is down 40 percent. Youthful exuberance has been cut in half, and high spirits are at an all-time low.
I don't understand it. I got them at the same place I buy Mother's dresses. Good Lord! Mother's in the park!
He's embiggened that role with his cromulent performance!
Yes, Go to Work with Your Parents Day! Tomorrow, you will learn by doing and apply your knowledge of fractions and gym to real-world situations!
Ah, Superintendent Chalmers, welcome. I hope you're prepared for an unforgettable luncheon.
But what if... I were to purchase fast food and disguise it as my own cooking? Ooh, delightfully devilish, Seymour.
Superintendent! I was just... eh... stretching my calves on the windowsill! Isometric exercise. Care to join me?
Superintendent, I hope you're ready for mouth-watering hamburgers!
I phoned ahead.
Uh, Superintendent Chalmers! What's wrong?!
Oh... oh, good. This will sound crazy but at first I... I thought I'd enraged you again.
The cold, hard process of elimination places the 'H' squarely in your locker!
I... ah, brandishing your buttocks is only getting me angrier!
Yes, I am sure. Sure as sure can be.
I believe it was a boking accident.
Boy for sale! Boy for sale!
Hmmm. These campaign buttons are all partisan. Don't you have any neutral ones? "May The Better Man Win?"... "Let's Have a Good, Clean Election?" That sort of thing?
Missy, you just talked yourself right out of a sale.
It's a party, mother. I was invited.
Now, Bart... son... I don't know what you think you saw, but, uh, let me assure you...
Like you for... Bart, if life has taught me one lesson repeatedly, it's to know when I'm beaten. Let's talk deal.
Bart Simpson to the Principal's Office. Post haste.
What are you getting at?
Attention, Springfield. We have barricaded ourselves in the school and are not coming down until our demands are met.
No! You get off of my school!
I... have a bomb.
Reverend, this is Principal Skinner. I'm facing a crisis and I didn't know to whom to turn.
Hmm. Looks like you've already got an enemy, Chief. Y'know, folks 'round here don't much care for law and order types.
Lucky for you, this was just a warning gator. The next one won't be corked.
Ah, it's not rented, Chief -- it's stolen. That's the Louisiana Governor's mansion. It's been missing for eight months.
He's gradually getting away, Chief.
Oh Mother, you are still the master of deception.
It's true. I was in his platoon... But they said you were killed on that scouting mission!
Well, this was a big bust. Come on, kids. Let's go home to our mothers.
O-okay, Libya. Exports.
Uh, over here.
Kids, this is Robby the Automaton.
Young man, the school dress code specifically forbids the wearing of earrings... unless you're of gypsy extraction.
Lisa, Channel 6 is launching a children's news program. And they've asked me to select an outstanding student to be anchorchild.
We have a new student, Lisa. And I want you to show her the works. The lunchroom, the tree...
